summary.text:
# 调查母星系 / Survey Home System

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: common/event_chains/00_event_chains.txt:163 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

事件链定义 survey_home_system（common/event_chains/00_event_chains.txt:163）。在随游戏发行的全部文件中，没有任何脚本对它执行 begin_event_chain，也没有任何事件、特殊项目或 on_action 引用它的名称，因此玩家在正常游戏中不会看到这条事件链。

Event-chain definition survey_home_system (common/event_chains/00_event_chains.txt:163). In all files shipped with the game no script runs begin_event_chain for it and no event, special project or on_action mentions its name, so the chain never appears in normal play.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

日志文本“勘测母星系”（在探索银河之前先勘测自家后院）。原先开启它的事件 progress.1 在 events/progress_events.txt:35-54 中整段被注释掉，因此这个事件链没有启用。

Log text "Survey Home System" (survey our own backyard before venturing out). The event that used to start it, progress.1, is commented out entirely in events/progress_events.txt:35-54, so the chain is not used.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

本导读未单列分支与结局；分支随各事件在上文说明，互斥结果在阅读器中以“择一”框显示。/ This guide does not list branches separately; they are described with each event above, and exclusive outcomes are boxed in the reader.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

本导读未单列条件差异；条件随各事件在上文说明，阅读器按文明设定显示可能的版本。/ This guide does not list conditions separately; they are described with each event above, and the reader shows the possible variants for the chosen empire profile.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已在整个游戏目录搜索该事件链名称，只有定义本身。
  Searched the whole install for the chain name; only the definition itself exists.
